edit.description: one projection off the carried verdict onto `TickOutcome`, called by both return arms instead of spelled per arm
the walled render-refusal case reads the outcome's bucket beside the verdict's

summary: A walled wave's `TickOutcome` mirrors `unclassedWalls` alone; the six stage-failure buckets its verdict carries are dropped, though each field's own doc promises presence

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

acceptance: Both `Dispatcher.tick()` return arms spell the `TickOutcome` mirroring through one projection, so on the walled-wave `failed` arm `outcome.<bucket>` and `outcome.verdict.<bucket>` agree for every bucket the shape declares, and a bucket added later reaches both arms or neither. A completing tick reports exactly what it reports today.
tests: a walled wave's tick outcome names the render failure its verdict carries
notes: `src/Dispatcher.ts:1111`-`:1125` is the walled arm's whole return literal: `unclassedWalls` is read off `carried.verdict`, the six siblings are not, though each doc (`:475`-`:501`) reads "Present only when the tick hit at least one". Measured: the fixture at `tests/Dispatcher.test.ts:11240` asserts `verdict.renderFailures` holds one row on that arm, where `outcome.renderFailures` is absent. Target shape: one projection, both arms.
